transport.preservation_limits: Read existing engineering tolerances from the certified atlas configuration; do not select new limits from these results.

protocol.selection: No cohort deletion, feature dropping, imputation reselection or transport reselection. No outcome-prediction models are fitted.
protocol.inference: One independent contribution per patient; repeated hours stay within patient. Within-source comparisons only for independent-sample tests. Clinical summaries use observed values only.
protocol.interpretation: Report effect sizes, confidence intervals, test statistics, p-values and Benjamini-Hochberg q-values within named families. No significance-based QC gate, biological invariance claim or test-based method reselection.
protocol.coverage: Keep all clinical patients. Atlas analyses use eligible patients; unsupported eligible targets keep their original embeddings. Report unscorable groups explicitly.
protocol.small_groups: Bootstrap intervals require minimum_patients. Wilson proportions and Newcombe-Wilson risk differences remain available for nonempty binary groups, including zero events, with denominators shown.
protocol.demographics: Age retains source deidentification. Gender and race use recorded source labels; no forced cross-source vocabulary equivalence and no inference of biological sex or ancestry.
protocol.source_limits: Cross-version MIMIC person independence is unknown. eICU patient splits are not unseen-hospital validation. Strict-culture subgroup tensors retain proxy onset; small subgroup estimates are descriptive.
protocol.execution: Run scripts sequentially. Each script replaces only its own tables and updates one shared manifest. Analysis QC checks implementation and provenance, never requires favorable scientific results.

readiness.interpretation: Coverage/constant-value/imputation flags support later feature selection; they never remove patients or features and are not universal clinical thresholds.

tests.multiplicity: BH within dataset, question, population, scenario, comparator and test; all tested features/strata in that family.
tests.assumptions: Welch tests allow unequal variances and rely on independent patient summaries and adequate sample size. U/Kruskal-Wallis test distributions; medians alone are not their general null. Hospital differences mix case mix and recording effects. Constant/small groups receive explicit unavailable tests.
